# Playground: first useful agent

[Course guide](../../docs/course-guide.md) · [Exercise](exercise.md) · [Worked solution](solution.md)

## 01 · Playground: first useful agent — 20 min

**Outcome:** Compare an ordinary answer with an evidence-backed answer, then expose missing information.

> An answer becomes useful when we can show where it came from and what it cannot establish.

### Teaching beats

- 0–5: open the signed-in Agents playground and describe the task.
- 5–10: compare an answer without evidence with one using the supplied file/tool.
- 10–17: run the missing-information exercise and revise instructions.
- 17–20: identify one real tool call and one unsupported claim.

### Explain and show

- Instructor prep: open https://platform.openai.com/agents/new while signed in before class. The release browser check reached the login page; authenticated controls, tool availability, and export were not verified. Check how the actual UI maps to an API session.
- Start with a narrow task: summarize the supplied research paper and find one related record. Make evidence and missing information visible in the output.
- Use the same small paper and CSV as later lessons. Do not assert that the playground exports code or that a tool is available without checking the actual UI.
- If the playground cannot run the task, use the managed API demo below and its quickstart. If managed access is unavailable, use the Responses demo or labeled offline fallback.

### Narrow prompts

> Read the supplied paper. Write a short research brief with two supported claims, an exact supporting quotation for each, and one limitation. Use only the supplied evidence. Label anything absent as not found.

> Find one related paper record in the supplied CSV. Label it as a secondary summary and distinguish it from evidence in the PDF.

> What was the exact cost of training the system, and does this paper prove it works for every domain? If the evidence does not say, write not found. Do not estimate.

### Completed demo

Run from the repository root. Live commands make API requests; choose one prepared runtime rather than running every alternative in class.

```bash
uv run python -m course demo --runtime managed --output outputs/playground-fallback
uv run python -m course demo --runtime responses --output outputs/playground-responses
uv run python -m course demo --runtime offline --output outputs/playground-offline
```

**Open:** [course/prompts.py](../../course/prompts.py) · [assets/paper.pdf](../../assets/paper.pdf) · [assets/papers_database.csv](../../assets/papers_database.csv)

### Exercise

- Use the first prompt and save the answer. Underline every factual claim and attach its supporting quotation.
- Ask the missing-information prompt. Classify each answer as supported, not found, or unsupported.
- Change one instruction to require explicit missing evidence and separate primary from secondary sources; rerun the same question.

### Expected solution

- A good answer contains only claims justified by the provided text, short exact quotations, and clearly labeled limitations. A confident unsupported answer fails even if it is well written.
- The broad every-domain claim cannot be inferred from a narrow experiment. Training cost must be not found unless an actual source passage provides it.
- A useful revision is: Each claim needs a source identifier and exact quote; if a source does not establish the answer, put the request in not_found. Treat CSV records as secondary summaries.

**Checkpoint:** Show the tool name, its input, and returned evidence. Identify a claim that goes beyond the source, even if the prose sounds confident.

**Fallback:** Run the API-based completed demo. If no live path is available, show the offline result and ask students to audit evidence; do not describe that as a playground run.

**Official references:** [Agents playground](https://platform.openai.com/agents/new) · [Managed quickstart](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agents-api/quickstart) · [Agent configuration](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agents-api/configuration)
